requirements: R1: Patch the synchronization code to correctly identify non-merged GitHub PRs and update internal tasks from 'done' back to active, bypassing fraudulent system status reports

slices.title: Patch synchronization logic to revert 'done' tasks for unmerged PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the synchronization patch for this epic, I want to validate PR states directly against GitHub and ignore fraudulent coverage reports, so that tasks are no longer falsely marked as done
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task marked 'done' with an unmerged GitHub PR,
When the synchronization patch is executed,
Then the task is reverted to an incomplete state,
And the patch logic is verified directly via unit tests to fulfill QA requirements.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive done task statuses for unmerged PRs from current level to 0%
